name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
grip: Neutral at the bottom, rotating naturally as the arms rise; wrists stay straight.
stabilizers: Trapezius and serratus anterior - scapular control
description: Raise the arms out to the sides against the dumbbells' weight while keeping the torso still. The side shoulders lead the movement.
setup: Stand comfortably with a dumbbell in each hand and knees soft.
Hold the weights beside the thighs with a small bend in the elbows.
instructions: Lift the arms out and slightly forward of the body in a comfortable path.
Keep a similar elbow bend as elbows and upper arms rise together.
Stop around shoulder height, or earlier if that is your comfortable range.
Lower slowly without swinging the torso or dropping the weights.
commonMistakes: Swinging the hips to start each repetition.
Shrugging to finish or turning the thumbs sharply downward.

logging.example: Two 8 kg dumbbells: record 8 kg per dumbbell.
logging.note: Keep seated, machine and cable versions as distinct variants.

variantNote: Elbow angle and arm path distinguish this movement from an upright row or front raise.
